## Updates
- Hardened the hero animation hook with reduced-motion detection, a 4 s fallback timer, and a `revealSceneImmediately` helper so the stars/earth/moon layers are restored even if GSAP never spins up. This prevents the white background state the screenshot showed and keeps the dev hotkeys functional.  
```26:92:apps/app/src/hooks/useUltraterrestrialAnimation.tsx
const [forcedReveal, setForcedReveal] = useState(false)
const [shouldReduceMotion, setShouldReduceMotion] = useState(false)
...
const revealSceneImmediately = useCallback(() => {
  if (hasRevealedRef.current) return
  hasRevealedRef.current = true
  setShowFluidOrbs(false)
  setTitleVisible(true)
  setNavVisible(true)
  ;[stars.current, shootingStars.current, prometheus.current, moon.current, earth.current, nav.current, title.current].forEach(
    (target) => {
      if (target) {
        gsap.set(target, {
          opacity: 1,
          visibility: 'visible',
          filter: 'none',
          scale: 1,
          x: 0,
          y: 0,
          clearProps: 'all',
        })
      }
    }
  )
}, [])
```
```103:167:apps/app/src/hooks/useUltraterrestrialAnimation.tsx
useEffect(() => {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return
  const mediaQuery = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)')
  const updatePreference = () => {
    const matches = mediaQuery.matches
    setShouldReduceMotion(matches)
    if (matches) {
      setForcedReveal(true)
      revealSceneImmediately()
    }
  }
  ...
}, [revealSceneImmediately])

useEffect(() => {
  if (shouldReduceMotion || forcedReveal) return
  let fallbackTimer: number | null = null
  const checkElements = window.setInterval(() => {
    const earthCanvas = document.querySelector('#earth-canvas')
    const moonCanvas = document.querySelector('#moon-canvas')
    const prometheusEl = document.querySelector('.prometheus-container')
    if (earthCanvas && moonCanvas && prometheusEl) {
      window.clearInterval(checkElements)
      if (fallbackTimer) window.clearTimeout(fallbackTimer)
      hasRevealedRef.current = false
      setIsReady(true)
    }
  }, 120)
  fallbackTimer = window.setTimeout(() => {
    window.clearInterval(checkElements)
    setForcedReveal(true)
    revealSceneImmediately()
  }, 4000)
  return () => {
    window.clearInterval(checkElements)
    if (fallbackTimer) window.clearTimeout(fallbackTimer)
  }
}, [revealSceneImmediately, shouldReduceMotion, forcedReveal])
```

{
  "contentsAfterEdit": "# HomeRenderingFix_PSUEDOCODE\n\n## Objective\nStabilize the landing hero so the cosmic background, moon, and typography match the intended art direction regardless of animation timing issues.\n\n## High-Level Steps\n1. Harden &#96;useUltraterrestrialAnimation&#96; so it always reveals the scene (with or without the cinematic GSAP sequence).\n2. Update &#96;Home&#96; layout markup to include the animation container ref, a static gradient backdrop, and ensure background layers are pointer-event safe.\n3. Refresh &#96;TitleAlt&#96; typography to use the design-system font stack and a neutral glow instead of the blue gradient.\n4. Fix &#96;StarsBackground&#96; utility classes so the SVG never intercepts pointer events.\n\n## Detailed Pseudocode\n\n### 1. Animation Hook\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\ninitialize state: isReady, showFluidOrbs, titleVisible, navVisible\nadd new state: forcedReveal (boolean) default false\n\nuseEffect -\u003e determine prefersReducedMotion; if true, call revealSceneImmediately()\n\nuseEffect -\u003e start interval to check for '#earth-canvas', '#moon-canvas', '.prometheus-container'\n  when found -\u003e clear fallback timeout, setIsReady(true)\n  also set fallback timeout (~3500ms); if it fires first, set forcedReveal(true) and call revealSceneImmediately()\n\nfunction revealSceneImmediately():\n  set showFluidOrbs false\n  set titleVisible true\n  set navVisible true\n  for refs.stars/shootingStars/prometheus/moon/earth/nav/title -\u003e gsap.set opacity 1, clear transforms\n\nuseGSAP callback:\n  if (!isReady || forcedReveal or prefersReducedMotion) return\n  build custom eases\n  set initial states (using gsap.set)\n  create timeline exactly as before\n  onComplete -\u003e clear overlay\n\nCleanup ensures flash overlay removed even on fallback.\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 2. Home Layout\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\u003cdiv ref={refs.container} className='...' style bg #000\u003e\n  add \u003cdiv className='absolute inset-0 z-0 bg-[radial-gradient(...)] pointer-events-none' /\u003e\n  keep Stars/Shooting stars wrappers but rename pointer-none -\u003e pointer-events-none\n  ensure CanvasCursor sits above backgrounds but below overlay\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 3. TitleAlt Typography\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\nuse fontFamily 'var(--font-monument-grotesk)'\nset text color to transparent gradient from #f4f9ff to #d7e4ff\nadd soft glow (#8ec5ff) but reduce intensity\nmaybe add subtle letter spacing adjustments\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 4. StarsBackground Utility Fix\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\nupdate wrapper div className to use 'pointer-events-none'\nupdate svg className likewise\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 5. Preserve Cosmic Backdrop During Timeline\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\nProblem: gsap.set() drives stars/shootingStars opacity to 0 at timeline start,\n         so when the flash overlay runs the background disappears (looks like a white wash).\n\nSolution Steps:\n1. Remove the initial gsap.set(refs.stars...), gsap.set(refs.shootingStars...) calls.\n2. Remove the tl.to(...) steps that fade them in later; let them stay rendered from mount.\n3. Optionally clamp their opacity via CSS if needed, but keep them \u003e= 0.8 throughout.\n4. Keep flash overlay effect (short burst) but ensure it no longer corresponds to a blank canvas.\n5. Test reload: background should remain visible even while the flash overlay plays.\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Acceptance Validation\n- Load page with JS disabled -\u003e static gradient prevents white flash.\n- Wait \u003c4 seconds -\u003e fallback ensures Moon, stars, nav visible even if 3D canvases delayed.\n- With motion preference reduce -\u003e timeline skipped but view still composed.\n- Typography renders using Monument Grotesk with soft glow instead of solid blue.\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n",

  "contentsAfterEdit": "# HomeRenderingFix\n\n**Timestamp:** 2025-11-25 15:05 UTC  \n**Author:** GPT-5.1 Codex\n\n## Summary\n- Hardened the hero animation pipeline so the scene now renders the cosmic backdrop, fluid shader, Earth, and Moon even when GSAP timelines fail to initialize.\n- Refreshed the landing typography to align with the Monument Grotesk stack and removed the bright blue glow that clashed with the art direction.\n- Ensured decorative background layers are always visible by adding a static gradient base layer and fixing pointer-event flags on the SVG star fields.\n- Prevented the GSAP timeline from zeroing out the star layers, so the cosmic background stays visible even while the flash overlay plays.\n\n## Modules Affected\n- &#96;apps/app/src/hooks/useUltraterrestrialAnimation.tsx&#96; – Added reduced-motion detection, fallback reveal logic, container refs, and kept star layers visible throughout the sequence.\n- &#96;apps/app/src/layouts/home/home.tsx&#96; – Attached the new container ref, introduced a radial-gradient safety background, and re-layered the decorative components with pointer-events guards.\n- &#96;apps/app/src/layouts/home/TitleAlt.tsx&#96; – Updated typography to use the design fonts, softened glow effects, and removed the blue gradient fill.\n- &#96;apps/app/src/components/backgrounds/shooting-stars/stars-background.tsx&#96; – Corrected pointer-event classes so the SVG never blocks input.\n\n## Animation/Data Flow Notes\n- The &#96;useUltraterrestrialAnimation&#96; hook now waits for the Earth, Moon, and Prometheus canvases but also starts a 4s fallback timer.
